stem: Which characteristic of the story best identifies it as a fable?

options.label: A
options.text: The story includes a long journey by the main character.

options.label: B
options.text: The story treats the animal characters as if they were human.

options.label: C
options.text: The story explains an interesting fact about snakes.

options.label: D
options.text: The story describes how a hero saves others.
